items.headline: Nike (NKE) reports fiscal 2026 Q4 results: revenue $11.0B (down 1%), full-year revenue $46.4B, EPS $0.72 for Q4 and $2.10 for FY, with gross margin boosted by $986M expected tariff recovery and net income down 3%
Nike announces CFO transition: David M. Denton to become EVP and CFO effective August 17, replacing Matthew Friend, who will stay through early September to support handover
